l.i: Nomina de pateo Praesulis ipse capit.
Bercola fortitur quod dat Vorlonia flumen
Bercola collecto rapitur dum latius amne
Ex alia ruris parte receptat aquam,
Illa sed exurgens Hamerani prodita campo
Hic geminas uno circulat amne molas,
Sed non ante fuit, fertur quod Bercola nomen,
Nomen at incertum contulit ora loci.
Dum tot colligitur rivis, tot flumina passim
Vrbs veteri credit numen inesse cruci,
Bercola pralustri simulac defecit ab urbe
Bercola dum Zephyri partibus urget iter.
Pronus ab urbe cadit qua sternitur Isala ponte
Et totidem retro grande peregit iter.
Isala paulatim dexter diverit ab Arcto
Nubifer hunc gelido Cirrius Orbe capit.
Et varie lect; flumen adauget aquis.

page.notes: The right-margin note "Stwol." is printed beside the line "Leva Tuoldenum discedit Welsenalevam"; its position is approximate. Several words in the verse are doubtful due to the blurred scan and show-through from the reverse; the transcription of the lines is provisional. Marks "[?]" are not placed on each doubtful word because of the overall poor legibility. The final "VI" at lower right is a printed mark and is not part of the text.
